errors.evidence: The value for the blue bar (Gesetzlicher Mindestlohn) in 2021 is 9,55. The value for the purple bar is 12,80. However, the description mistakenly reports the value 10,52 for the blue bar in the following year (2022) when it is not associated with any bar in the chart. This causes a cascade of errors. The description reports the pair as 9,55/12,80 for 2021, which is correct, but the subsequent values are shifted and incorrect.

The description incorrectly assigns the value 10,52 to the blue bar for the year 2022. In the chart, the blue bar for 2022 is clearly labeled with the value 12,00. The number 10,52 appears to be a misplaced label in the source image, located between the 2021 and 2022 data groups, but not associated with the 2022 bar.

The description incorrectly assigns the value 12,00 to the blue bar for the year 2023. In the chart, the blue bar for 2023 is labeled with the value 12,41. The description uses the value from the previous year (2022).
